method: Every decoded frame in selected range; Farneback flow; Shi-Tomasi/Lucas-Kanade forward-backward tracking; RANSAC 2D similarity; regional brightness/contrast/Laplacian sharpness. Seed=39, OpenCV threads=1. Values describe pixels, not physical camera motion.
limitations: A fixed region can contain multiple moving layers.
Cuts, dissolves, blur and occlusion can invalidate motion estimates.
Sky flow includes camera and cloud movement; cannot uniquely separate their physical causes.
Do not integrate affine transforms across flagged transitions.
